出版者的话

古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”而我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。

现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。

情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养，而幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。

当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。

这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。

让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

Publisher's Note

The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to get angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and with the right person, to the right degree—that's difficult.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time, in the right place, and with the right person.

In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills. Those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this ability, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.

While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation through experience. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this time create lasting neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.

Currently, the practice of parent-child co-reading emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional intelligence. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and growing with sunlight and rain.

This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks addresses specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their inner journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a valuable reference for parents during shared reading.

Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey with this series!

海底世界被塞拉芬搅得片刻不宁，大家简直拿他没办法，终于忍无可忍地一起去找海豚爸爸告状。海豚爸爸就是海豚国王，非常威严，他警告塞拉芬：“我要求你……不要……否则……听明白了吗？”

Teacher Says to You
A Fair Word for the Little Dolphin Prince
Serafin is an extraordinary little dolphin who will one day inherit the throne from his father, the Dolphin King. How enviable that must be!
But, speaking of Serafin, he's actually quite a headache. His "crimes" are numerous! Look, he woke up the sleeping tuna Theo, scared the pufferfish Baptiste, spun the jellyfish Molly dizzy, and disturbed the whale Madeline and the clownfish. After every prank, he'd hide in his private territory—the back of a sunken ship—smirking with complete indifference.
The underwater world was in constant turmoil because of Serafin. Everyone was at their wit's end and finally went together to complain to Dolphin Dad. Dolphin Dad is the Dolphin King, very stern. He warned Serafin: "I require you... not to... otherwise... do you understand?"
Reading this, I suddenly felt like I've seen this mischievous, prank-loving little Serafin somewhere before. Where could it be? Ah! He might be the Dingding in class, or the little fat kid next door... It seems like everyone has a "little dolphin prince" like this around them, whose pranks are hard to defend against.
Parents are just like that stern Dolphin King, never having thought

page_text_ocr_zh:
塞拉芬为什么要这样做吧？或许是他不知道该怎样结识朋友，或许是他 在捉弄别人的过程中觉得“好玩儿”而忽略了未知的危险或后果……

对于像塞拉芬这样顽皮的孩子，也许只有经历了挫折才能成长吧！故事的作者就为他特意安排了一次特殊的经历，让他遇到了一件很危险的事情。在紧急关头，大家不计前嫌，帮助小塞拉芬脱离了危险。小塞拉芬也由于这一次遭遇开始反思自己的行为，认识到以前犯下的错误。说到这儿，你是不是已经开始有点儿喜欢这个海豚小王子了？你是不是也很想知道小塞拉芬到底发生了什么危险的事情？还是让我们赶紧来读故事吧！

因为被冷落而感到孤单，所以才会用搞恶作剧欺负人的方式来引人注意，期望获得更多的关爱。其实，很多爱搞恶作剧的孩子都有着丰富的想象力与创造力。他们天生是小探险家、小冒险家。我们不必大惊小怪，不妨在安全的前提下给他们更多的包容、理解和引导。虽然这个故事是写给小孩子的，但是希望爸爸妈妈们也能一起来反省一下我们和孩子交流的方式。要知道，孩子身上的问题，原因往往在父母身上。

（保定市教科所教研员 刘育红）
page_text_en:
Why does Seraphin behave this way? Perhaps he doesn't know how to make friends, or perhaps he feels it's 'fun' to tease others and thus ignores the unknown dangers or consequences...

For mischievous children like Seraphin, perhaps only through experiencing setbacks can they grow! The author has specially arranged a unique experience for him, leading to a very dangerous situation. In the critical moment, everyone sets aside their grievances and helps young Seraphin escape danger. Seraphin also begins to reflect on his own behavior and realizes the mistakes he made before. At this point, aren't you starting to like this dolphin prince a little? Don't you also want to know what dangerous thing actually happened to young Seraphin? Let's hurry and read the story!

Because they feel lonely when ignored, they resort to playing pranks or bullying others to attract attention and seek more care. In fact, many children who love playing pranks have rich imagination and creativity. They are naturally little explorers and adventurers. We don't need to be overly alarmed; instead, we can offer them more tolerance, understanding, and guidance under safe conditions. Although this story is written for children, it also hopes that parents can reflect together on how we communicate with our children. Remember, the root of children's problems often lies with their parents.

(Researcher, Baoding Education Research Institute, Liu Yuhong)
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《海豚王子塞拉芬》的导读页，由保定市教科所教研员刘育红撰写，分析了主角塞拉芬调皮捣蛋的原因，探讨了孩子通过挫折成长的必要性，并呼吁家长反思教育方式，强调理解与引导的重要性。

The little dolphin Seraphin lives in the ocean with his mom and dad.
His dad is the king of the dolphin tribe.
Seraphin knows that when he grows up,
he will become king just like his dad. He feels very proud.
The little dolphin Seraphin swims super fast,
he often plays jokes on the fish living in the ocean,
and teases them with pranks.

"Serafin, I've heard you often tease your friends. Is that true?"
"This... isn't true!" the little dolphin answered, thick-skinned,

Dolphin Dad said seriously:
"I require you to pay attention from now on,

otherwise I'll have to punish you! Do you understand?"
"Understood, Dad," the little dolphin said, blushing.

The next day,
Tio the tuna finally found a perfect spot to take a good nap.
He made his bed comfortable with soft coral,
